mapper.select: SELECT COALESCE(SUM(total_cost), 0) AS totalCost, COALESCE(SUM(total_tokens), 0) AS totalTokens, COALESCE(SUM(input_tokens), 0) AS inputTokens, COALESCE(SUM(output_tokens), 0) AS outputTokens, COALESCE(SUM(cached_input_tokens), 0) AS cachedInputTokens, COUNT(*) AS requestCount, COALESCE(AVG(total_cost), 0) AS avgCostPerRequest, CASE WHEN COUNT(*) = 0 THEN 0 ELSE SUM(CASE WHEN request_status = 'SUCCESS' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / COUNT(*) END AS successRate FROM ai_token_usage

SELECT
DATE_FORMAT(created_at, '%Y-%m-%d %H:00') DATE_FORMAT(created_at, '%Y-%m-01') DATE_FORMAT(created_at, '%Y-%m-%d') AS bucket, COALESCE(SUM(total_cost), 0) AS totalCost, COALESCE(SUM(input_tokens), 0) AS inputTokens, COALESCE(SUM(output_tokens), 0) AS outputTokens, COUNT(*) AS requestCount FROM ai_token_usage
GROUP BY bucket ORDER BY bucket ASC

SELECT provider, model_name AS modelName, COUNT(*) AS requestCount, COALESCE(SUM(input_tokens), 0) AS inputTokens, COALESCE(SUM(output_tokens), 0) AS outputTokens, COALESCE(SUM(total_cost), 0) AS totalCost, COALESCE(AVG(total_cost), 0) AS avgCost FROM ai_token_usage
GROUP BY provider, model_name ORDER BY totalCost DESC

SELECT business_scene AS businessScene, COUNT(*) AS requestCount, COALESCE(SUM(total_tokens), 0) AS totalTokens, COALESCE(SUM(total_cost), 0) AS totalCost FROM ai_token_usage
GROUP BY business_scene ORDER BY totalCost DESC

SELECT model_name AS name, COALESCE(SUM(total_cost), 0) AS value FROM ai_token_usage
GROUP BY model_name ORDER BY value DESC LIMIT #{limit}

SELECT user_id AS name, COALESCE(SUM(total_cost), 0) AS value FROM ai_token_usage
GROUP BY user_id ORDER BY value DESC LIMIT #{limit}

SELECT DATE_FORMAT(created_at, '%Y-%m-%d %H:00') AS bucket, COALESCE(SUM(total_tokens), 0) AS totalTokens, COALESCE(SUM(cached_input_tokens), 0) AS cachedInputTokens FROM ai_token_usage
GROUP BY bucket ORDER BY bucket ASC
SELECT COUNT(*) AS requestCount, COALESCE(AVG(total_tokens), 0) AS avgTokens, COALESCE(MAX(total_tokens), 0) AS maxTokens, COALESCE(AVG(total_cost), 0) AS avgCost FROM ai_token_usage

SELECT user_id AS userId, COUNT(*) AS requestCount, COALESCE(SUM(total_cost), 0) AS totalCost FROM ai_token_usage
GROUP BY user_id ORDER BY totalCost DESC
